findings.note: Poeltl averages 8.1 PPG this season and scored 8, 3, 11, 9 and 6 in his last five games, with 17-32 minutes. He came off the bench for two games, then returned to the starting lineup against Washington on Nov 18.

RotoWire notes there show he scored 19 on Nov 7 and 18 on Nov 10, playing 31 minutes in each, after injuries opened up minutes. He has also been dealing with left shoulder bursitis, and Collin Murray-Boyles has been taking a large share of the center minutes.
From last season (March 2026): Poeltl scored 21 points on 9-12 shooting with 18 rebounds in 36 minutes in a win over the Pistons, so he has had a big game against this opponent before.
